caption:
You're ready to cut them off. But there's a difference between cutting someone away and setting what came out of joint back in place. (Galatians 6:1 devotional)

When a brother falls you reach for the knife, as if he were a limb to amputate rather than a bone to reset. But "restore" is a surgeon's word — to ease a dislocated joint back into place — and the gentleness it takes isn't weakness but strength under the bridle, like a war-horse under control. Remember you were reset, not thrown away; his fall is your mirror, "lest you too be tempted," and the gentleness Christ used on you is now yours to hand him.
